question_uz: Nega O'zbekiston Respublikasining mustaqilligi va tinchligini asrash har bir fuqaroning muqaddas burchi hisoblanadi?
question_en: Why is defending and preserving Uzbekistan's independence and peace considered the sacred duty of every citizen?
options_uz: Chunki mustaqillik — bu xalqimizning ko'p asrlik kurashlari, buyuk ajdodlarimiz orzusi, milliy o'zligimiz, tinchligimiz va yorug' kelajagimizning yagona kafolatidir
options_en: Because independence is the fruition of centuries of struggle, the dream of our ancestors, and the bedrock of our liberty and future
hint: 💡 Maslahat: Istiqlol — bebaho ne'mat.
why_right: To'g'ri javob: «Chunki mustaqillik — bu xalqimizning ko'p asrlik kurashlari, buyuk ajdodlarimiz orzusi, milliy o'zligimiz, tinchligimiz va yorug' kelajagimizning yagona kafolatidir». Tarix shuni ko'rsatadiki, o'z erkidan mahrum bo'lgan xalq o'z yurtida qulga aylanadi; mustaqillik esa inson sha'ni, farovonligi va millat abadiyatining bosh omilidir.
why_right_en: Correct answer: «Because independence is the fruition of centuries of struggle, the dream of our ancestors, and the bedrock of our liberty and future».

question_uz: Yangi O'zbekiston yoshlariga yaratilayotgan imkoniyatlarning bosh maqsadi nima?
question_en: What is the ultimate purpose of empowering the youth in New Uzbekistan?
options_uz: Yoshlarni chet elga butunlay chiqarib yuborish
Zamonaviy bilim, IT ko'nikmalari va xorijiy tillarni egallagan, vatanparvar, yangi Renessans (Uchinchi Renessans) poydevorini quruvchi barkamol avlodni tarbiyalash
options_en: Nurturing an educated, patriotic, tech-savvy generation to build the foundations of the Third Renaissance
hint: 💡 Maslahat: Uchinchi Renessans — ma'rifatli, bilimli va ijodkor yoshlar qo'lida.

why_right_en: Correct answer: «Nurturing an educated, patriotic, tech-savvy generation to build the foundations of the Third Renaissance».
